positions.title: Data Scientist
positions.description:
Act as the technical lead for a team of 8-10 engineers.
Design and develop Spark spatio-temporal framework for streaming pattern analysis.
Evaluate distributed models to characterize behavior.
Architect infrastructure to processes high-volume streaming datasets.
Optimize performance and identify bottlenecks in near-real-time streaming pipelines.
Develop Ansible playbooks to automate a complex system deployment.
Use GitLab CI to automate a continuous delivery process.

* Radiant Solutions acquired by Maxar

positions.title: Technologist
positions.description:
Developed a full stack Angular application with a micro-service architecture.
Used MongoDB and Elasticsearch to provided indexing and faceting.
Built charts to visualize data with D3 and Leaflet.

* HumanGeo acquired by Radiant Solutions

positions.title: Data Scientist
positions.description:
Used Spark and Tableau to analyze large data sets.
Designed custom analytics using Hive with expertise from analysts.
Developed Spring web application to improve user workflow.
Acted as Scrum Master for a small team.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Built data ingestion pipeline supporting both streaming and batch operations.
Developed a configuration driven distributed ETL framework.
Modeled data into an RDF-like common topology.

* Potomac Fusion acquired by Sotera Defense Solutions
